train_one_epoch: train a detection model for one epoch with an optimizer, data loader, and learning rate warmup scheduler
evaluate: evaluate a detection model on a test data loader and return COCO evaluator metrics
get_iou_types: get the IoU types for a detection model based on whether it is MaskRCNN or KeypointRCNN
review_train_one_epoch: review the train_one_epoch function to understand loss computation, gradient steps, and learning rate warmup logic
refactor_evaluate: refactor the evaluate function to support custom evaluation metrics beyond COCO
